newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Lack of rules limits Ecuador investment - U.K. envoy.
newsitem.headline: Lack of rules limits Ecuador investment - U.K. envoy.

text.p: A lack of clear rules is restricting foreign investment in Ecuador, outgoing British Ambassador Richard Lavers said in comments published Wednesday.
The lack of rules mean that "big investors decide to keep away or simply move to other countries," Lavers said, according to the daily newspaper El Universo.
Lavers, who is wrapping up his posting in Ecuador, said he had had to intervene in cases where British citizens have been threatened or detained in commercial disputes.
U.S. Ambassador Leslie Alexander said in late May that corruption made Ecuador unfit for investment, although he conceded that President Fabian Alarcon was struggling against the problem.

Ecuador is pinning its hopes for economic growth on attracting foreign investment in its energy and telecommunications sectors. It hopes to sell 35 percent of state telecom company Emetel in mid-September.
